_source: Category:Gate Guard on BG Wiki (manifest-gateguard.json) plus Argus (NPC) (manifest-gateguard2.json). 11 guards: 4 Bastok, 4 Windurst, 3 San d'Oria.
_why: Nation mission pages write Start as "Any Bastok Gate Guard" -- a ROLE, not a name. The DAT has no NPC of that name, so it can never draw a marker. The role has to be resolved to the actual guards, and each is recorded with its own page id, revision and hash so the resolution is auditable and the build needs no network.
_argus_was_missed: The first pass found 10 and Port Bastok silently had none. The category walk DID enumerate Argus, but the page titled "Argus" is a disambiguation for a Hecteyes notorious monster in Maze of Shakhrami; the guard is at "Argus (NPC)". The category filter correctly rejected the monster and nothing followed the disambiguation. fetch_wiki.py follows REDIRECTS but not DISAMBIGUATION links -- a second hop this cache does not take, and the reason a nation quietly lost a guard rather than erroring.
_naming: The key is the entity name the CLIENT spawns, so the wiki disambiguator is stripped: the article is "Argus (NPC)", the marker key is "argus". The name comes from the page TITLE and never from |Name=, because Rakoh Buuma's page writes |Name={{PAGENAME}} -- a template, which trusting that field put into the roster verbatim.
